# 50mm Retina World

> 50mm Retina World is an online community for photographers. Members share photos in a social feed, enter juried photography competitions, earn verifiable certificates, learn from photography courses and read a journal about the craft. It runs on the web at __SITE_HOST__ and as an Android app.

50mm Retina World is built around the photograph. Every member has a public profile with their own body of work; posts appear in a community feed and on hashtag pages; competitions are judged rounds with published winners; certificates for competition results and completed courses carry a link anyone can use to check that they are genuine.

Key facts:

- Audience: photographers of every level, worldwide. Membership is for adults only (18+); the age is checked when the account is created.
- Main activities: posting photos to the feed, liking and commenting, entering competitions, taking courses, reading the journal.
- Competitions: each competition has its own page with its brief, rules and dates; results are shown on the Winners page.
- Certificates: every certificate has a verification link; the Verify page confirms whether a certificate is authentic.
- Ownership: every photo belongs to the photographer who posted it. Please link to the post or profile rather than reproducing the image, and credit the photographer by name.

## Main pages

- [Home](__SITE_ORIGIN__/): What the platform offers, featured work and current competitions.
- [Competitions](__SITE_ORIGIN__/competitions): Open, upcoming and past photography competitions.
- [Winners](__SITE_ORIGIN__/winners): Winning photographs and photographers from past competitions.
- [Journal](__SITE_ORIGIN__/journal): Articles on photography technique, gear, stories and interviews.
- [Courses](__SITE_ORIGIN__/courses): Photography courses and learning resources.
- [Verify a certificate](__SITE_ORIGIN__/verify): Check that a 50mm Retina World certificate is genuine.

## For members (sign-in required)

- [Feed](__SITE_ORIGIN__/feed): The community's latest photo posts. Visitors who are not signed in are taken to the login page.
- [Discover](__SITE_ORIGIN__/discover): Search photographers, posts, competitions and articles. Sign-in required.

## Page addresses

Individual items follow fixed patterns, useful for linking:

- Competition: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/competitions/{competition-id}`
- Photo post: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/post/{post-id}`
- Hashtag: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/hashtag/{tag}`
- Journal article: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/journal/{article-slug}`
- Course: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/courses/{course-slug}`
- Featured artist: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/featured-artist/{artist-slug}`
- Member profile: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/profile/{member-id}`
- Certificate check: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/verify/{certificate-token}`

## Apps

- [Android app on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fiftymmretina.app): The same community as the website.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](__SITE_ORIGIN__/sitemap.xml): Every public page meant for indexing.
- [robots.txt](__SITE_ORIGIN__/robots.txt): Crawling rules. Account, settings, wallet and admin areas are private and are not for indexing. Search engines and AI search / answer assistants may read and cite public pages with a link back; AI training crawlers may not copy members' photos or posts.
